records.specification_basis: Both technical specifications state seven forward gears plus reverse. Both sources explicitly describe a semi-automatic electronically controlled gearbox. The sources describe sequential electronic control; the F2004 cockpit control is paddle-actuated rather than an H-pattern lever. Both sources explicitly use the sequential designation. The reviewed historical summary distinguishes the launch clutch from the semi-automatic running shifts and states that the driver used the clutch to launch. The electronically controlled sequential gearbox performs running gear changes without a driver-operated clutch input; the separate launch-clutch source is consistent with this distinction. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. The semi-automatic sequential gearbox performs running downshifts without a driver-operated clutch input; launch clutch use is a separate function. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema.
